test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Success requires hard work.

options.text: Hard work is to be required for success.
Hard work were to be required for success.
Hard work is required for success.
Hard work had been required for success.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Hard work is required for success.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are some rules to keep in mind when changing a sentence from active to passive voice.
 
• The **object **in the active voice sentence becomes a **subject **in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, "**hard work**" becomes the **subject **from the object(active voice) in the passive voice.
 
• The main verb in an active voice sentence takes up the past participle form when it is changed to a passive voice sentence.
 
• The verb **requires**( V1) changes to **required**(V3) in the passive voice.
 
• In the given sentence, since there is no agent who does the action. This is an example of passive voice without an agent.
 
• The preposition **for **is used to convey the **purpose **of the action.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**
